blind_spot: מ9's level-1 → level-2 drill works by accident, and nothing in the repo would catch the day it stops. ReportsPage.jsx:323 routes a row door only when `next.id != null`; the m09 level-1 rows carry drill_key {kind:'customer', bucket:'d61_90', customer_id:401} — the kind IS in ROW_DOOR_KINDS, but the id field is named customer_id, so the branch is skipped and the key falls through to p_drill, which is what the card requires ('רמה 1 ⇒ יורדת רמה'). Rename that field to `id` in the RPC (or broaden the shell's check), and every level-1 row silently stops drilling and navigates to /customers/401 instead — the report is left, not deepened. No test covers it: ReportsPage.test.jsx:536 tests exactly the OTHER shape ({kind:'customer', id:401} ⇒ navigate), and FinanceTab.test.jsx's level-1 test only asserts that onDrill received the key. Checkable in one edit: change customer_id to id in the m09 level-1 row builder (migration 20260916063400_module11_e2_rpcs_finance_fixes.sql:966 area) and run `npx vitest run src/modules/11_reports` — it stays green while the page breaks. (Separately, and resolved rather than left hanging: the ▼ displacement my per-character probe reported on m07's fourth tile was a wrap artefact — re-measured at 1280 and 900, the arrow sits at the compare line's right edge in both, see results/lensB-finance/m07-tile4-1280.png.)
